title: Enchanted Teacup Animation Laboratory
description: The user operates an animation laboratory where a translucent teacup sits on a pedestal surrounded by orbiting interpolation test objects. By adjusting sliders and clicking interactive controls, the user manipulates transmission color, animation playback speed, lighting hue, camera orbit radius, teacup scale, and object orbit speed, then validates and exports the final scene configuration.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads both DiffuseTransmissionTeacup.glb and InterpolationTest.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the teacup centered at the origin on a reflective circular pedestal (MeshStandardMaterial with metalness 0.9). Position the InterpolationTest model so it orbits the teacup in a circular path at radius 3, playing all embedded animations via AnimationMixer. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 6) looking at the origin, with OrbitControls enabled. Add an HDR-style lighting rig: one warm DirectionalLight, one cool HemisphereLight, and a PointLight near the teacup that casts shadows. Enable shadow mapping on the renderer. Create an HTML overlay panel with six labeled controls: (1) a color picker that changes the teacup material transmission color by traversing its mesh children and setting material.attenuationColor, (2) a slider 0.1-3.0 controlling the AnimationMixer timeScale for the InterpolationTest animations, (3) a slider 0-360 controlling the PointLight hue using HSL conversion, (4) a slider 2-10 controlling the orbit radius of the InterpolationTest model, (5) a slider 0.5-2.5 controlling the teacup uniform scale, (6) a slider 0.1-5.0 controlling the orbit angular speed in radians per second. Add a Validate button that checks all six parameters are not at their default values and displays a green success banner or red error banner listing which parameters still need adjustment. Add an Export button (enabled only after successful validation) that logs the full parameter state as JSON to the console and displays a confirmation toast. Animate the orbit in the render loop using elapsed time multiplied by orbit speed. Use a dark gradient background via scene.background set to a Color. Ensure the renderer uses antialiasing and toneMapping set to ACESFilmicToneMapping with exposure 1.2.
